title: For one paranormal researcher, Minnesota's spooky and strange can be found year-round
excerpt: Chad Lewis calls himself a researcher of the “weird and unusual.” He has authored over 20 books on the supernatural, and extensively lectures on his findings.

Halloween may be over but our next guest says there's always something spooky and mysterious lurking around the corner.

Chad Lewis has spent decades researching the weird and unusual across Minnesota. He does public presentations on Minnesota's lesser known paranormal history.

Lewis joined Minnesota Now host Nina Moini to talk about his favorite haunts.
